question: Identify the scheme that was launched by the Prime Minister on 8 April 2015 for providing loans upto Rs. 10 lakh to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on **8 April 2015**.
 
• It aims to provide loans up to Rs. 10 lakh to the **non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises**.
 
• The loans are classified as **Shishu** (up to Rs. 50,000), **Kishore** (Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 5 lakh), and **Tarun** (Rs. 5 lakh to Rs. 10 lakh).
 
• This scheme is implemented by **Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs, and NBFCs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)**

 
 
• PMMY stands for Pradhan Mantri Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd.
 
• The scheme was launched to provide financial support to small business units.
 
• MUDRA provides refinance to various lending institutions such as Banks, NBFCs, and MFIs for lending to micro units having a loan requirement up to Rs. 10 lakh.
 
• The primary objective is to promote and ensure the growth of micro-enterprises in the country.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Rojgar Yojana**
 
 
• It is not a specific scheme launched by the Indian Government.
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)**
 
 
• Launched in 2005, MGNREGA is aimed at enhancing the livelihood security of households in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)**
 
 
• PM-SYM is a pension scheme for unorganized workers launched in 2019.
 
• The scheme assures a monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 after attaining the age of 60 years.
